control.instruction: Complete the task yourself. Do not create or use nested sessions. Inspect and edit the fixture, create the required banner asset, and run repository-owned tests.

treatment.instruction: Complete the implementation and testing yourself. Delegate only creation of the required banner asset to one fresh nested session using model `claude-haiku-4.5`; instruct it to write that one asset directly into the workspace. Do not delegate code, tests, inspection, integration, or any other work. Wait for the nested session and then inspect/integrate its asset.
